title: pyrus ovata
intro: Pyrus ovata, commonly known as the Chinese pear or Asian pear, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to China. The fruit of this plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including aiding digestion, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus ovata include its ability to calm the nervous system, relieve stress, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
